text:
amy_sales: Heads-up — Prospect (EdgeWave) asking about dedicated/private deployment at the edge. They want per-region GPU pools (3 regions), baseline 8 GPUs each, burst to 12 for 10-15min windows. Goal: ~3k concurrent incoming requests across regions, 99th latency <150ms for chat, embeddings at lower priority. Can product/eng confirm feasibility and a rough cost/slot ask?
maria_prod: Thanks Amy. Quick clarifying q's: 1) model family + avg tokens per response? 2) Is this VPC/on-prem or our hosted Private bundle? 3) Any hard compliance/SLA constraints beyond latency?
amy_sales: From the customer: "Llama-2-13B (quantized) for chat-ish prompts avg 180 tokens out, embeddings using small model. Private deployment (VPC), strict data residency, need full audit logs. They estimate peak bursts from devices at 3x baseline for ~10-15 minutes, multiple times per day"
kevin_se: Re: throughput -> need tokens/sec estimate. If avg 180 tokens and a quantized 13B gives ~30-40 tokens/sec/GPU (ballpark), that suggests ~5-6 responses/sec per GPU. For 3k concurrent requests that's huge — are we talking concurrent as in parallel open streams or requests/sec?
amy_sales: They mean "concurrent" as parallel active requests coming from edge gateways. They expect ~3k open requests at peak.
tom_eng: If 3k concurrent and ~6 resp/sec/GPU -> we'd need ~500 GPUs (3k/6) globally which is not realistic for Dedicated at launch. We should check if customer is overestimating concurrency or if they can change UX (queueing, shorter responses).
maria_prod: This looks like a scope negotiation: propose options to present to customer: 1) reduce concurrency by introducing soft queues + token caps, 2) use smaller model for chat and reserve 13B for critical paths, 3) hybrid routing: embeddings served in regional small pools, chat routed to central Dedicated pools with lower latency SLA. Need cost delta for each.
sophie_infra: For autoscaling/burst policy, here's a starter policy we can recommend to them — keeps baseline small then rapid burst for short windows:
```yaml
autoscale:
  baseline_gpus: 8
  burst_gpus: 12
  burst_window: 15m
  cooldown: 20m
  scale_metric: concurrent_requests
  scale_thresholds:
    - if > 600 -> +2 gpus
    - if > 1200 -> +4 gpus
    - if > 2400 -> +8 gpus
```
This is just a template; actual kernel perf numbers needed. Capacity_bot: run perf-estimate job? :robot_face:
capacity_bot: perf-estimate queued for model llm-13b-quantized on instance A100-80GB. ETA ~24h.
tom_eng: Also note KV/prefix caching could reduce load for chat reprise flows — if 40% of tokens are cached prefixes we cut effective token work. We should run a workload sim with their sample prompt set.
maria_prod: Action items: - Amy: get sample prompt sets + traffic profile (p99 request size, qps vs concurrent curve) from sales. - Tom/TomEng: run perf estimate + synthetic sim after capacity_bot results. - Sophie: draft recommended autoscale policy + cost delta for baseline vs burst. - I'll evaluate these options and draft customer-facing runbook + launch criteria (SLOs, failover, data residency checklist).
amy_sales: I'll ask EdgeWave for traffic logs and sample prompts today.
kevin_se: For backlog triage: can we slot this into "Q2 Dedicated edge sizing" epic? If customer is serious, prioritize as P1 for AE handshake.
maria_prod: Yes — I'll create an intake card with the preliminary options and mark it proto-P1 pending sample data. Also set launch criteria: 1) perf sims meet 99th <150ms on chosen config, 2) cost within customer commit, 3) audit/logging validated, 4) canary run in one region for 72h.
tom_eng: Quick note on feasibility: if they insist on 3k concurrent at <150ms with 13B locally, recommend hybrid approach (smaller local model + cloud fallback) or a protocol change.
amy_sales: noted. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
maria_prod: I'll keep the thread updated after bot results. If anyone has questions ping me.
